---
title: "`r params$report_title`"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
params:
  items_rds: NULL
  report_title: "qPCR Report"
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{longtable}
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
items <- readRDS(params$items_rds)
```

```{r report_body, results='asis'}
if (length(items) == 0) {
  cat("Keine Inhalte ausgewaehlt.\n")
} else {
  item_tabs <- unique(vapply(items, `[[`, character(1), "tab"))
  for (tab in item_tabs) {
    cat("##", tab, "\n\n")
    tab_items <- Filter(function(x) x$tab == tab, items)
    for (item in tab_items) {
      cat("###", item$title, "\n\n")
      if (item$type == "plot") {
        if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
          if (!is.null(item$plot)) {
            print(plotly::ggplotly(item$plot))
          } else if (!is.null(item$plotly)) {
            print(item$plotly)
          } else {
            cat("_Kein Plot verfuegbar._\n\n")
          }
        } else if (!is.null(item$plot)) {
          print(item$plot)
        } else {
          cat("_Kein Plot verfuegbar._\n\n")
        }
      } else if (item$type == "table") {
        if (!is.null(item$data) && nrow(item$data) > 0) {
          table_str <- if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
            knitr::kable(item$data, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, escape = TRUE)
          } else if (rmarkdown::pandoc_to("docx")) {
            knitr::kable(item$data, format = "pandoc", escape = TRUE)
          } else if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
            knitr::kable(item$data, format = "html", escape = TRUE)
          } else {
            knitr::kable(item$data, escape = TRUE)
          }
          cat(table_str, "\n\n")
        } else {
          cat("_Keine Tabellendaten verfuegbar._\n\n")
        }
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
}
```
